description_en: Queries the list of driver channels in an edge instance
description_zh: 查询边缘实例中的驱动通道列表
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-edge-instance-channel --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --instance-id 6GaTtvTj7vJhiS000000 --driver-id 9c1ae7bd59f1469abbdccc9592000000 --channel-name le_name0 --current-page 1 --page-size 15 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryEdgeInstanceChannel

parameters.description_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for the public instance. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.

parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the edge instance. On the **Edge Instances** page of the [IoT Platform console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the target edge instance name to obtain the ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) operation to obtain the ID.
parameters.description_zh:
边缘实例的ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。
